item.title: Bucks Week Ahead: Clean slate
item.description: The Bucks return to action later this week, and they have some work to do in order to make it to at least the NBA postseason play-in tournament.

item.title: Urban spelunking: Exploring the history of the Tasting Room building
item.description: A UWM class spent the 2025 fall semester studying the history of the building on Humboldt and Kane that most recently housed the Tasting Room. I talked to their instructor and did a little digging on my own, where I met house-mover John Tuszkiewicz.

item.title: Rufus Du Sol will play American Family Insurance Amphitheater this summer
item.description: The Australian trio announced Tuesday morning it will perform at the American Family Insurance Amphitheater as part of a 23-date North American tour.

item.title: Cafe Corazon teams up with Diageo & Casamigos for National Margarita Day class
item.description: Mark your calendars for this Feb. 22 Margarita-making masterclass in Bay View.

item.title: Friends of MADACC grant funds microchip scanners for every Milwaukee firehouse
item.description: Thanks to a grant from the Friends of MADACC, all 32 Milwaukee Fire Department stations in the city will receive microchip scanners to help firefighters identify lost dogs and reunite them with their owners.

item.title: Amilinda brings tasca vibes to Milwaukee with Portuguese Sandwich Hour
item.description: Chef Gregory León channels the flavors and feel of Portuguese tavern culture with mouthwatering sandwiches, served for a limited time on Thursdays, counter only.

item.title: ZX Sushi brings all-you-can-eat sushi Downtown at Riverside Lofts
item.description: If your downtown game plan has ever included "Let's just order one more roll," here's some good news.

item.title: Old World Wisconsin announces opening date for new welcome center
item.description: When Old World Wisconsin, a Wisconsin Historical Society site, celebrates its 50th anniversary on July 4, 2026, it will also celebrate the opening of its new welcome center.

item.title: Lombardi Brewing launches coffee service on Friday
item.description: Lombardi Brewing Company, which opened in September in the former City Lights Brewing facility at 2200 W. Mount Vernon Ave. in the Menomonee Valley, is moving in to coffee, too. The espresso machine will begin to hiss on Friday.

item.title: Sam's Place Jazz Cafe to close this week, ending five-year run in Harambee
item.description: Like many other restaurants, Sam's cites ongoing economic challenges and shifts in the local business landscape as reasons for the closure.
